# Second Sight web app

Vite + TypeScript (no framework). Map: MapLibre GL 6.17, calendar: custom SVG.

```bash
cd app
npm install
npm run dev        # http://localhost:5173
npm run build      # type-check + production build into dist/
```

Optional: set `VITE_PMTILES_URL` (in `app/.env.local`) to a Protomaps `.pmtiles` archive to use the
`@protomaps/basemaps` light style. Without it the map falls back to the keyless OpenFreeMap Positron style.

Shortcuts: `1`-`7` tabs, `L` language, `M` colour mode, `R` series. State lives in the URL hash,
e.g. `#kalender?aoi=khg-sebangau&m=2015-09&mode=count&s=harm&lang=id`.

## Calendar data contract

The calendar reads `public/data/demo_monthly.json`. It is **synthetic sample data** generated by
`scripts/make-demo-data.mjs` and the UI shows a "Data contoh" badge while `meta.synthetic` is true.
The pipeline export (EXP-01) replaces it with the same shape:

```json
{
  "meta": { "synthetic": false, "unit": "fire cell-days, Aqua-MODIS equivalent scale",
            "baseline": "2003-2022 median per calendar month", "last_month": "2026-11" },
  "rows": [ { "aoi_id": "khg-sebangau", "year": 2015, "month": 9, "...": "..." } ]
}
```

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `aoi_id` | string | AOI id (`khg-sebangau`, `kalteng`, `riau-kampar`, `sumsel-oki`, `indonesia`; see `src/aoi.ts`) |
| `year`, `month` | int | 2001-2026, 1-12. Missing rows (future months) render as empty cells |
| `H` | number or null | Harmonised fire cell-days on the Aqua-MODIS scale; null when unobserved |
| `H_lo`, `H_hi` | number or null | 90% interval ("9 dari 10") |
| `A_raw` | number or null | Raw MODIS count |
| `V_raw` | number or null | Raw VIIRS count (null before 2012) |
| `sensor_used` | `"MODIS"` or `"VIIRS"` | Sensor behind the value; drives the Raw/Per-sensor series |
| `baseline_median` | number or null | Median `H` for this calendar month over the baseline period |
| `pct_rank` | number 0-1 or null | Percentile of `H` among the same calendar month; ≥0.9 draws the anomaly ring |
| `obs_class` | `"good"`, `"partial"`, `"unobserved"` | Observability: partial = thin hatch, unobserved = heavy hatch |
| `flag_nrt` | boolean | Provisional near-real-time value: dashed border |
| `agreement` | `"A"`, `"B"`, `"C"` | Triangulation class shown in the tooltip |
